verdict.rationale: Sentry's Alerts system explicitly allows defining pre-defined rules that trigger automatically on events (new issue creation, thresholds) and take actions like Slack notifications, ticket creation, webhooks, or other integrations, and Autofix/Seer automatically scans and triages issues as they arrive. This directly matches the rule-based automation story, though evidence doesn't detail more complex AI-native conditional logic or custom scripting beyond built-in alert rule types. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of rule complexity and any evidence of AI-specific rule authoring (vs. standard alert rules), and confirmation of webhook/action reliability at scale.
